source.order: Alternate baseline/candidate order for each pair.
source.exclusion: Reject both sides of a pair that overlaps Cargo build/test activity, sampled every 500 ms. Wait for a five-second quiet window before each pair.

install.order: Use the runner paired, alternating binary order.
install.exclusion: Reject the entire run if it overlaps detected Cargo activity. Preserve rejected attempts.

scheduling: Finish build/test gates before timing. Run source and install measurements sequentially.
prior_warmup_attempts: Preserved locally, but superseded by the computed-property correction before final measurements.
